earnings.title: Cambridge, Mass. – October 28, 2026
highlights: Third quarter 2026 total revenue of $2.8 billion increased 11% year-over-year; Growth Portfolio 1 revenue of $1.26 billion, increased 49% year-over-year, representing 63% of Core Pharmaceutical 2 revenue, including a strong first full quarter contribution from the acquired Apellis products
GAAP diluted EPS of $(0.14) driven primarily by transaction-related charges; Non-GAAP diluted EPS of $2.62, reflecting $284 million of acquired IPR&D, upfront and milestone expense
$202 $121 67% Continued sequential growth; U.S. in-market sales of $107M

1 Growth Portfolio includes EMPAVELI, QALSODY, SKYCLARYS, SPINRAZA, SYFOVRE, VUMERITY, ZURZUVAE, plus Biogen's 50% share of net revenue and cost of sales, including royalties, from the LEQEMBI Collaboration

quotes.text: Our third quarter results demonstrate that Biogen has returned to growth. We’re seeing the strength of our Growth Portfolio – including the first full quarter of results from Apellis products – which helped drive double-digit revenue growth and an approximately 50% year-over-year increase from our growth products.
quotes.by: President and Chief Executive Officer Christopher A

outlook: Full year 2026 Non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance: Biogen raises the lower end of the reported range to $12.20 to $13.00 from $12.00 to $13.00 reflecting ongoing business strength and Apellis dilution favorability
Biogen expects combined Non-GAAP R&D expense and Non-GAAP SG&A expense to be approximately $4.95 billion for the full year 2026.

items.heading: We are substantially dependent on revenue from our products.
Our long-term success depends upon the successful development of new products and additional indications for our existing products.
If we fail to compete effectively, our business and market position would suffer.
Our business may be adversely affected if we do not successfully execute or realize the anticipated benefits of our strategic and growth initiatives.

We depend on relationships with collaborators and other third parties for revenue, and for the development, regulatory approval, commercialization and marketing of certain of our products and product candidates, which are outside of our full control, and if these relationships fail, our business may be adversely affected.
Our results of operations may be adversely affected by current and potential future healthcare reforms including those contained in the PPACA, IRA, OBBBA, MFN and executive orders.
